title: Discussion: prompt escapes the Shiny interface
description: Just recording this experience. My first attempt at using ggbot2, with something quite boring: ```r ggbot2::ggbot(iris) ``` I then asked it: "make the fanciest 3D plot you can". It promptly opened another browser window with a fully-interactive plotly plot. Looking at `prompt.md` this doesn't seem completely forbidden, but it was still surprising. It was nice that I was still able to continue with other requests. When I then asked it a few prompts in to produce a plotly plot it then insisted that it did not have that capability and could only access a subset of packages! Speaking with @georgestagg IRL it seems unlikely we can prevent (even random, unintentional) jailbreaking with the current `eval(parse(.))` model, but just noting that this is currently possible. Perhaps a tighter prompt may get us some of the way there without changing the internals completely.
